1  ITEM NO.801 COURT NO.5 SECTIO  S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A  RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS  Petition for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.209  (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 18012023  in CRMBA No. 47772/2020 passed by the High Court of Judicature at  Allahabad)
 ADIL Petiti  VERSUS  STATE OF U. P. Respon  (FOR ADMISSION and I.R. and IA No.31742/2023EXEMPTION FROM FILING  C/C OF THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT and IA No.31740/2023EXEMPTION FROM  FILING O.T.)
 Date : 19052023
This petition was called on for hearing today.

CORAM :
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURYA KANT  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE J.B. PARDIWALA  For Petitioner(s)

For Respondent(s)
 Mr. Vishwa Pal Singh, AOR  UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.
Upon being mentioned by learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, the matter is taken on board.

2. The order dated 08052023 passed in Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.2098/2023 is modified and the same shall read now as under: The petitioner seeks his enlargement on bail on regular bail in FIR No.098/2020 dated 18032020 registered at Police Station  Mandi, District Saharanpur, U.P. under Sections 376D, 366 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), 1860.
